# ADR-0008: The payload is generated by the system

**Status:** Accepted
**Date:** 2026-08-06

## Context

If every agent writes the message it hands to the next one, every hop in the chain is a
rewrite — and the message degrades along it. It was observed in the reference system and
is the origin of the practice brought from there.

## Decision

The handoff payload is **generated by the system**, not written by the agent. The agent
fills in structured fields; the delivered body is synthesized.

## Alternatives considered

- **Let the agent write the message** — rejected because every hop rewrites it, and the
  message degrades along the chain.

## Consequences

- **Positive:** it eliminates degradation by successive rewriting; the agent cannot inject
  prose into the message.
- **Impacts:** every stage must declare the structured fields the agent fills in.
